fields.label: Source code folder
fields.description: Choose a repository, a folder with source and docs, or a Git comparison folder prepared for Code verifier.

choices.label: Extract docs and add custom rules

fields.label: Rule documents
fields.description: Current requirements separates historical reports, tutorials and code examples from obligations. Exclusions remain available for review.

fields.label: Specification paths
fields.description: Enter one path or pattern per line, relative to the source folder, such as docs/retries.md or docs/*.md. Leave blank to use Rule documents.

web_ui.title: Code verification
web_ui.description: Explore rule results and captured source evidence in the conversation workspace.

registration.writes: static-html web_ui.json handle in the run output

starter_questions: How can I try the synthetic code sample?
What must I review before approving the rules?
Which results are unknown, and what should we verify next?

setup_guide.introduction: Try the sample task app to see how a written rule compares with its code, or choose your own source folder. You’ll review the rule list before I check it.

sample.title: Sample task app
sample.description: Use the bundled task app and its short specification. You’ll approve the extracted rules before verification.
sample.expected_output: A rule list to approve, followed by verdicts linked to the sample code.

real.introduction: Choose a repository with source and requirements, then choose which rules to extract.

fields.label: Saved explanation preferences
fields.description: Managed in Memory. Changes Chat wording only; domain work and approvals keep their existing controls.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll prepare the rule list from your selected inputs. When Review rules appears, check the wording before you approve it.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the verification report, select a rule, and follow its citation to the supporting code.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open report.md in the output folder to see the verdict and source evidence for each approved rule.
